name: B10-0126/2024 (Verts/ALE) – Urgent need to revise the Medical Devices Regulation
title: Urgent need to revise the medical devices regulation
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is asking the European Commission to improve how the rules on medical devices work. It wants faster and more predictable checks before devices can be sold, more transparency about supply problems and safety decisions, and better support for devices for rare diseases. It also wants a full review of the rules before they are reopened, with patients and health workers involved.

- No law changes yet; Parliament asks the Commission to act and review the rules.
- Affects patients, makers of medical devices, and national authorities across the EU.
- Next: the Commission and member states are asked to respond and improve how the rules are applied.
